text: Monitor ZIM reopening and preserve the R&D draft
description: ZIM is technically plausible for a German Aimparency company, but ordinary applications and sketches have been temporarily stopped since 7 July 2026 because of constrained budget; only specified international-partner calls are exempt. Preserve meta/zim-projektskizze-draft.md, recheck the official stop notice monthly, and do not spend founder time attempting submission until reopening. If it reopens, revalidate legal entity, German establishment, R&D novelty, project start, eligible personnel costs, own financing, and the then-current funding rate before adapting the draft.

status.comment: Technical draft preserved, but ordinary ZIM applications have been paused since 7 July 2026. Monitor the official reopening notice; do not submit meanwhile.
